mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to tightened financing conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0% in the prior month
regime_hint: Rising Fed Funds in a restrictive policy phase
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified restrictive period (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor market employment) of at least 2% coincides with a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return, reflecting stronger labor demand and investor optimism.
failure_condition: Over a 12-month rolling window, 60-day forward returns do not outperform a baseline of zero mean (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (goods orders) grows faster than CPIAUCSL (inflation) over the prior quarter, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive, indicating robust demand outpacing price pressures.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth > CPIAUCSL quarterly growth
failure_condition: The condition holds but 20-day forward returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of more than 5% predicts a negative S&P 500 5-day forward return, reflecting weakening supply chain activity and potential market pessimism.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative in at least 70% of such events (p > 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 4% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is positive, signaling labor market strength and rate-cut expectations.
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day forward return during the two-month low unemployment window (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS (retail sales) above 700 billion dollars and HOUST (housing starts) below 1500 units are associated with a negative S&P 500 60-day forward return, indicating overheating demand and cooling housing.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 700B and HOUST < 1500 in the same month, for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative during the identified pattern (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 3.5% for three months predicts a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as labor market tightness supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during the low-unemployment period (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a period where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are rising but FEDFUNDS growth exceeds CPIAUCSL by at least 0.5 percentage points, the S&P 500 5-day forward return is positive, reflecting expectations of future rate stability.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS monthly growth > CPIAUCSL monthly growth + 0.5%
regime_hint: Calm monetary expansion with controlled inflation
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when the condition holds (p > 0.05).
